issue_context.title: [Feat]: support `${label:name}` syntax for extracting label values in the alarm info line
issue_context.body:
### Problem

The [current syntax](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/agent/health/reference#alarm-line-info) is `$label:name`. It requires the expression to be surrounded by spaces, so any of the following don't work:

- `some text ($label:name) some text` 
- `some text $label:name1, $label:name2 some text`
- `some text datacenter=$label:datacenter, node=$label:node some text` 

### Description

Add support for `${label:name}` syntax for extracting label values in the alarm info line.

The syntax is [partially supported](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/issues/14098#issuecomment-1340725643) but not really documented.

### Importance

must have

### Value proposition

1. better alarm info line
2. less error prone


### Proposed implementation

_No response_
